scope: Descriptive only; repeated observed failure conditions are not proof of avoidable mistakes or a causal effect. Seed repetitions within the same source are deduplicated; different sources with the same role/kind/frozen case args are counted. Unreported cases remain unknown. Does not modify primary acceptance or turn related task formulas into independent families.

failed_checks.scope: Observed failed checks only. Evaluation may stop early; unlisted cases are unknown.
